notes: any of is read as the partitive מִן, no כֹּל standing in the clause; the competing reading gives any to זֶרַע under rule 15, but there the noun already carries thy and any heads the partitive rather than determining the noun.
The italic through the fire and the object them are added, the Hebrew writing neither.

through is taken as part of the supplied phrase rather than as the causative verb's phrasal particle under rule 44; the particle reading would leave only the fire added, and the ASV italicizes only those two words.
